sections.heading: C — School bus signals, right of way and passing
sections.markdown:
## C — School bus signals, right of way and passing

FACT_ID: sec07-F01 | anchor: A01
On a road divided by a barrier, oncoming vehicles need not stop for a school bus with flashing red lights, but vehicles on the bus's side of the road must stop. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec07-F02 | anchor: A01
Flashing yellow hazard lights on a school bus mean proceed with caution. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec07-F03 | anchor: A01
Flashing yellow overhead lights on a school bus mean get ready to stop. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec07-F04 | anchor: A01
Flashing red overhead lights mean stop at least 20 feet from the bus and stay stopped until the red lights turn off or the bus moves on. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec07-F05 | anchor: A01
You must yield to other vehicles when turning right, including a right turn at a red light. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec07-F06 | anchor: A01
You must yield to other vehicles when turning left, whether out of a driveway or alley or while finishing a left turn on a green light. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec07-F07 | anchor: A01
A left turn on a red light also requires yielding to other vehicles. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec07-F08 | anchor: A02
Before turning left on red from one one-way street onto another, stop completely and look for traffic coming from your right. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F09 | anchor: A02
Turning left on red from a two-way street onto a one-way street requires a full stop, a scan to the right, and yielding to opposite vehicles turning right. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F10 | anchor: A02
When your light has just turned green, yield to any vehicles still in the intersection before you go. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F11 | anchor: A02
On a green light, turn left only after all oncoming traffic has cleared, and if the light turns red while you are in the intersection, finish the turn as quickly and safely as possible. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F12 | anchor: A02
At a stop sign or flashing red signal, stop completely and check traffic, using the stop line or crosswalk, or else a spot where you can see approaching traffic without entering the intersection. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F13 | anchor: A02
At a four-way stop, the first driver to arrive and stop goes first, and when two arrive together the vehicle on the left yields to the one on its right. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F14 | anchor: A02
At a malfunctioning traffic signal, stop completely, yield to vehicles already there, and yield to the vehicle on your right if you arrive together. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F15 | anchor: A02
At a flashing yellow arrow, yield to traffic before you complete your turn. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F16 | anchor: A02
At a T-intersection with no signals or signs, vehicles on the through road have the right of way. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F17 | anchor: A02
At a YIELD sign, slow down, check for traffic and be ready to stop. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F18 | anchor: A02
Be ready to yield to workers in construction or maintenance areas and when nearing or passing a stopped garbage, utility or road maintenance vehicle with flashing lights. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-F19 | anchor: A03
When an emergency vehicle approaches with red or blue lights and a siren, pull right next to the curb or edge, clear of any intersection, and stop until it passes or an officer waves you on. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F20 | anchor: A03
At a MERGE sign, adjust your speed and yield to through traffic so you can merge safely. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F21 | anchor: A03
Yield to pedestrians in a marked crosswalk, whether at an intersection or midblock, even when your light is green. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F22 | anchor: A03
Yield to children in or near a school zone crosswalk while school is in session, and to pedestrians with physical, hearing or visual disabilities. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F23 | anchor: A03
Yield to pedestrians on every turn at an intersection, whether or not lights or traffic control devices are present. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F24 | anchor: A03
Yield to pedestrians when stopping at a stop sign or flashing red light and at an intersection with a flashing yellow light. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F25 | anchor: A03
Where no traffic control devices exist, a pedestrian using an unmarked crosswalk on the driver's half of the road gets the right of way. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F26 | anchor: A03
Yield to a pedestrian who stepped into a crosswalk before the signal changed, and to one crossing from an alley, driveway, building or private road. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F27 | anchor: A03
A funeral procession has the right of way over all vehicles except fire trucks, ambulances and police vehicles. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F28 | anchor: A03
Procession vehicles must fly a fluorescent orange flag bearing a religious symbol such as a cross, a star of David, or a crescent and star. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F29 | anchor: A03
Cutting through a funeral procession is a civil infraction, though drivers are not required to pull over when they meet one. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F30 | anchor: A03
On a two-lane highway, pass only with a clear view of the left lane and oncoming traffic far enough away to give you the time and distance to pass safely. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-F31 | anchor: A04
After passing, do not cut back right until the whole vehicle you passed shows in your rearview mirror. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F32 | anchor: A04
You must be back in your lane before coming within 200 feet of an oncoming vehicle. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F33 | anchor: A04
Allow extra passing room when towing a trailer, pass only one vehicle at a time, and do not tailgate a vehicle that is passing slower traffic. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F34 | anchor: A04
Use extreme care when passing in the center lane of a three-lane road, since oncoming drivers may enter it too, and never use it to pass or merge when it is marked for left turns only. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F35 | anchor: A04
When someone is passing you, do not speed up or race them; let them finish safely. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F36 | anchor: A04
Passing on the right is allowed in limited cases but never by driving on the shoulder or off the road. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F37 | anchor: A04
You may pass on the right on a two-lane road with room when the vehicle ahead is turning left, on a multi-lane one-way street, on roads with two or more lanes each way, or where the road is widened for passing. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F38 | anchor: A04
Passing is banned when your side of the center has a solid yellow line, when no-passing signs are posted, or when a hill or curve hides oncoming traffic. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F39 | anchor: A04
Do not pass within 100 feet of an intersection or railroad crossing, or when a bridge, viaduct or tunnel within 100 feet blocks your view. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F40 | anchor: A04
Do not pass when oncoming traffic is too close, when you cannot see clearly ahead, or when the three-lane center lane is marked left turn only. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-F41 | anchor: A04
Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk or intersection for a pedestrian, in a posted no-passing construction zone, or when a school bus has stopped with red lights flashing. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0046]
